title: Lakshmi and the First Lamp
audience: A 20-second visual proof for the Diwali film: families and festival audiences, phones first.
tone: warm, quiet, luminous; a myth told by a friend, not a lecture
logline: One lamp is lit, the flame travels, and Lakshmi rises from the river with four hands: a lotus, and palms that give.

spine.want: to see why a lamp is lit for Lakshmi
spine.obstacle: the night is dark and the goddess is far away
spine.turn: the flame is carried hand to hand, and the river answers with a lotus
spine.button: the same flame reaches the home, the rangoli and the offering

narration.text: On the darkest night of Diwali, one lamp is lit, and the flame passes from hand to hand.
At the river, a lotus opens, and Lakshmi rises with four hands: a lotus, and palms that say give.
Draw the rangoli. Light the diya. Share what you have.
